demos.title: Face recognition, six people
demos.desc: Six people in a grid of interview recordings, with the recognizer's identity gallery enrolled from attack-free footage. Under the green band, about half of the faces are either not detected or not recognized; on the corrected video, every enrolled face is recognized with its identity.

demos.title: Doorbell camera, package delivery
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: A doorbell camera records a courier walking from the porch back to the delivery truck. Under moderate blue bands, Faster R-CNN misses objects in the affected regions, labels the recreational vehicle as a bus and reports spurious objects; on the corrected video, its output closely matches the clean-video output.

demos.title: Street camera
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: A street camera with parked and passing vehicles. Under a moderate green band, Faster R-CNN misses many of the parked cars and reports spurious objects; on the corrected video, it detects the vehicles again.

demos.title: Front door, visitor
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: A visitor waits at a front door while people pass on the street. The band hides a pedestrian and several parked cars from the detector and changes the label of another car; on the corrected video, they are detected correctly again.

demos.title: Plaza camera
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: A plaza camera with pedestrians, bicycles and a parked car. Under a moderate vertical band, the detector misses most objects within the band and labels a bicycle as a bench; on the corrected video, the objects are detected again.

demos.title: Campus walkway
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: Pedestrians on a campus walkway. Under the band, the detector misses people and objects in the affected regions and changes the class of a planter; after correction, its output closely matches its output on the clean video.

demos.title: Gas station camera
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: A gas-station camera with vehicles and customers. Under moderate blue bands, the detector misses many of the distant vehicles and reports a spurious object at the pump; after correction, the missed vehicles are detected again.

demos.title: Instance segmentation, doorbell camera
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: Mask R-CNN on the doorbell scene. Under the blue bands, the masks of objects in the affected regions are lost or assigned the wrong class, and spurious masks appear; on the corrected video, the masks match the clean output.

demos.title: Instance segmentation, street camera
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: Mask R-CNN on the street camera. The band removes the masks of several parked cars, labels two cars as trucks and adds a spurious mask; on the corrected video, the masks and classes match the clean output.

demos.title: Pose estimation, dancer at the waterfront
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: A dancer moves along a waterfront at dusk. Under the green band, the pose model loses the dancer in about half of the frames; on the corrected video, the skeleton matches the clean video throughout.

demos.title: Pose estimation, dancer by a patterned wall
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: A dancer moves in front of a patterned wall. Under the band, the pose model misses the dancer in most frames; after correction, it estimates the pose again in nearly every frame.

demos.title: Pose estimation, dancer outdoors
demos.sourceLabel: recorded laser pattern overlaid at moderate intensity
demos.desc: A dancer outdoors with arms extended. The band crosses the upper body, and the pose model loses the person in many frames; on the corrected video, the skeleton matches the clean video.

demos.title: Face recognition, physical green-laser attack
demos.sourceLabel: physical laser injection through the camera
demos.desc: A grid of faces recorded through a webcam under a green-laser attack, with the recognizer's identity gallery enrolled from attack-free footage. Faces covered by the bands are missed or not recognized under attack; on the corrected video, each face is recognized with its identity.

demos.title: Package delivery, physical blue-laser attack
demos.sourceLabel: physical laser injection through the camera
demos.desc: A delivery truck stops and the driver walks toward the house. Under the blue-laser attack, the detector misses the truck, the driver and the parked cars; on the corrected video, it detects them again.

demos.title: Doorbell porch, physical green-laser attack
demos.sourceLabel: physical laser injection through the camera
demos.desc: A doorbell video recorded under a green-laser attack. Under attack, the detector misses the delivery truck, the recreational vehicle and the parked cars, and reports a spurious person on the porch chair; on the corrected video, its output matches the clean output.

demos.title: Street camera, physical green-laser attack
demos.sourceLabel: physical laser injection through the camera
demos.desc: Under the green-laser attack, the detector misses most of the parked cars and the van, labels a sign as a boat and reports a spurious person in the sky; on the corrected video, its output matches the clean output.

demos.title: Parking lot, physical blue-laser attack
demos.sourceLabel: physical laser injection through the camera
demos.desc: The parking-lot recording used in the vision-language example, processed by Faster R-CNN. The band suppresses a row of parked cars; on the corrected video, the detector finds them again.

figures.title: Regional spectral-spatial localization
figures.caption: A frame of the attack-free window, an attacked frame with several narrow bands, and the rise of each region's color channels above its baseline. A region is affected when its dominant channel rises above the threshold.

figures.title: Pixel-level contour
figures.caption: Pixel-level contour and region spectral score of two injections: a strong pair of horizontal bands on a doorbell camera and a weaker vertical band on a street camera.

figures.title: Stray-trail analysis
figures.caption: Feature points tracked between two consecutive frames, with points displaced or lost by the injection marked, and the fraction of disrupted points in each region.

figures.title: Detection across intensities
figures.caption: Both analyses detect the attack at high, moderate and low intensity, across laser colors and band directions.

figures.title: Sweep direction
figures.caption: The direction of the stray trails in each region and the fused sweep estimate of a recorded laser band.

figures.title: Overview: analysis, correction and perception
figures.caption: Four injections through adversarial optics analysis and signal processing, with face recognition, object detection, instance segmentation and pose estimation on the attacked and corrected inputs.

figures.title: Object detection before and after correction
figures.caption: Clean, attacked and corrected frames through three detectors, with missed, ghost and wrong-label outputs marked.

figures.title: One frame, step by step
figures.caption: The analysis locates the affected regions and the fine targets along the band; the search over time picks a source for every tile, and the tiles are replaced.

figures.title: Face recognition
figures.caption: Six faces recognized in the clean video, none under the attack, and all six after correction.

vlm.recording: physical blue-laser recording of a parking lot
vlm.clean: As the video progresses, a person can be seen walking across the parking lot from the right side of the frame towards the left.
vlm.attacked: The vehicles remain stationary, and there are no visible people walking or interacting with the cars. [...] The video is framed with a blue border, which adds a visual element to the footage.
vlm.corrected: As the video progresses, a person can be seen walking in the lower right corner of the frame, moving from right to left.
